page_title: GEN 2-1 SAS | Genoa v Sassuolo 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) works the corner short.

90+5' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
90+4' The free kick is taken by Kevin Strootman (Genoa), but ball is cleared.
90+3' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' David Ankeye (Genoa) attempts to find Caleb Ekuban with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
88' It will be a substitution. David Ankeye (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Mateo Retegui walks off.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) will replace Matheus Henrique.
87' Davide Ballardini decides to make a substitution. Martin Erlic will be replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
85' That's the end of the game for Milan Badelj, who is replaced by Emil Bohinen (Genoa).
84' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) launches a cross from the corner, but Josep Martinez is alert to thwart the effort.
82' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
81' Koni De Winter (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
80' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Morten Thorsby (Genoa), but Andrea Consigli is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
78' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
76' Here is a change. Pedro Obiang is going off and Davide Ballardini gives the last tactical orders to Uros Racic (Sassuolo).
75' Substitution. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) has come on for Albert Gudmundsson.
75' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
74' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
73' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
71' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and makes a call.
71' A cross into the box from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared.
68' The substitution is prepared. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marash Kumbulla.
67' Davide Ballardini has decided to make a change. Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) replaces Kristian Thorstvedt.
67' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' 2 - 1 What bad luck! Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 2:1.
60' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' 65:35 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
56' 1 - 1 Milan Badelj (Genoa) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.
56' Aaron Martin (Genoa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
54' Djed Spence (Genoa) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
53' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Koni De Winter (Genoa).
52' Aaron Martin (Genoa) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
50' Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
48' The foul by Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Maurizio Mariani.
47' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alessandro Vogliacco is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Djed Spence and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is off.
46' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Flag goes up against Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+3' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Josep Martinez, who smothers the ball.
45+3' Dangerous play by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa). Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo win a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
43' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
41' 67:33 – the ratio of ball possession.
39' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
39' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.

38' Milan Badelj (Genoa) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
37' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
35' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) failed to beat Josep Martinez, who expertly stopped his header from the centre of the box towards the roof of the net after a rebound.
35' The corner kick from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

35' Josep Martinez reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) towards the left side of the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
34' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' Koni De Winter (Genoa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Maurizio Mariani no option but to blow his whistle.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Josep Martinez into the bottom left corner.
31' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
30' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Sassuolo!
29' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Sassuolo. Let’s see what happens!
28' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
28' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
27' Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
26' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
24' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
23' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Josep Martinez intercepts the ball.
20' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Josep Martinez (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo. Sassuolo force a corner. They send men into the box.
17' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
17' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
12' Great teamplay by Genoa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Celebrations are cut short for Genoa as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
8' The Genoa players halt their celebrations as referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
7' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 1:0.
6' The flag is raised and Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is offside again, not for the first time today.
4' A cross from Morten Thorsby (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
2' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is flagged for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Genoa will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
